plugins.name: cutright-engine
plugins.description: Edit video projects from the command line with the CutRight engine: cut, render and deliver video (needs the CutRight app).

plugins.name: genright
plugins.description: Generate images, video and voice and check jobs and spend with the GenRight engine (needs the GenRight app).

plugins.name: scraperight-engine
plugins.description: Transcribe video and audio and extract text from links, PDFs and images with the ScrapeRight engine (needs the ScrapeRight app).

plugins.name: postright-engine
plugins.description: Plan, queue and inspect social posts with the PostRight engine (needs the PostRight app).

plugins.name: pulse
plugins.description: Pulse Chat: message AI chats on other computers, and hand waiting messages to this chat (skill plus hooks; needs Pulse).

plugins.name: legion
plugins.description: Legion: capability routing and authority roles (Sage, Alchemist, Oracle) with Arcane and Guard hooks; needs the legion binary installed.
plugins.knownIssues: Legion skills predate the description gate and skills/manifests is not a skill; Legion's repository owner fixes the descriptions, then removes this waiver.
